Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 40

“In this, no effort is lost and no harm is done. Even a little of this practice protects one from great fear.”

An unusually reassuring verse. Unlike ritual, which fails if performed wrongly, this path keeps whatever progress is made. Nothing invested is wasted, however incomplete the attempt turns out to be.
